MCCI SG WITHOUT BEING SKYBATTLE ON GROUND:

- 1 game runs at a time
- games can have team sizes from 1-4
- all loot comes from chests, chest loot is completely randomized 
- LOTS of healing utility to keep fights going for a long time
- limited movement utility
- 2-3 maps, very large horizontally and vertically
- no defined spawns, teams/players can start the game at any point on the map
- rare items that encourage social play/coordinated target of a common enemy
- winners are given an icon in their name during future SG games (classic cayci roman numerals before name to represent number of wins)
- very slow shrinking border and small events that happen throughout the game. average game length ~30-50 minutes

for full cayci:
- all games are announced to the whole server
  - SG is starting in 5 minutes! Duos! (Map name)! Join with a party to play with a friend or solo to be paired with somebody!
- games don't run automatically 24/7
- games must be started/announced to the server by an mcci staff member/approved reputable game host
- crossteaming is allowed but limited
- the mcci staff member/host spectates the game and moderates for excessive crossteaming, cheating, toxicity, etc
- games are run 3-4 times a day, maybe once for each team size option daily
